prompt: One 16x16 tileable diagonal hatch, authored from the master palette by art/tools/make-zone-overlay.mjs and tinted per zone in code. A zone is a plan, not a machine (plan §5), so it reads as an annotation drawn over the world. Hand-authored because it must tile EXACTLY in both axes and must have binary alpha — the cook stage binarises alpha, so a soft wash would come back opaque and bury the field it annotates.
